"""Run the complete native induced two-color subgraph workflow."""

import argparse

from .workflow import EDGES, model_row, run_workflow


def main() -> None:
    """Report actual observed feasibility separately from the exact reference."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--maxiter", type=int, default=50)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    workflow = run_workflow(maxiter=args.maxiter)
    print("source_edges", EDGES)
    print("initial_CVaR", workflow.trace[0].cost)
    print("final_CVaR", workflow.optimizer.value)
    print("iterations", workflow.optimizer.iterations)
    print("actual_evaluations", workflow.optimizer.evaluations)
    print("converged", workflow.optimizer.converged)
    print("best_observed_feasible", workflow.best_feasible)
    for name, samples in (
        ("optimized", workflow.samples),
        ("uniform", workflow.uniform),
    ):
        print(f"{name}_observations", sum(row.count for row in samples))
        print(
            f"{name}_feasible_observations",
            sum(row.count for row in samples if row.feasible),
        )
    print("exact_bounded_reference", model_row(workflow.exact_reference))
    print("resources", workflow.program.report["resources"])
    print("temporary_workspace", workflow.program.report["workspace_qubits"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Original six-node induced two-color subgraph with actual native readout."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from examples.synthesis.applications.optimization.max_induced_k_color_subgraph.main import (
    DEFAULT_PARAMS,
    main,
)
from examples.synthesis.graph_optimization import (
    Evaluation,
    lower_tail_cost,
)
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.algorithms import NelderMeadOptimizer, NelderMeadResult

Assignment = tuple[int, int]
NAMES = ("a", "b")
DOMAIN: tuple[Assignment, ...] = tuple((a, b) for a in range(64) for b in range(64))
EDGES = (
    (0, 1),
    (0, 2),
    (0, 4),
    (1, 2),
    (1, 3),
    (1, 5),
    (2, 3),
    (2, 4),
    (2, 5),
    (3, 4),
    (4, 5),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Sample:
    """An observed joint assignment, original model checks and retained quantum cost."""

    assignment: Assignment
    objective: int
    colored_nodes: tuple[int, ...]
    double_colored: int
    directed_conflicts: int
    feasible: bool
    retained_quantum_cost: int
    count: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Workflow:
    """An actual optimization and sampling run with a separate bounded reference."""

    program: synth.Program
    optimizer: NelderMeadResult
    trace: tuple[Evaluation, ...]
    samples: tuple[Sample, ...]
    uniform: tuple[Sample, ...]
    exact_reference: Assignment

    @property
    def best_feasible(self) -> Sample | None:
        """Return the best actually observed feasible row, if present."""
        return next((row for row in self.samples if row.feasible), None)


def model_row(assignment: Assignment, count: int = 0) -> Sample:
    """Check original coloring constraints separately from the retained quantum cost."""
    if len(assignment) != 2 or any(
        isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or not 0 <= value < 64
        for value in assignment
    ):
        raise ValueError("assignment requires two six-bit unsigned integer words")
    if isinstance(count, bool) or not isinstance(count, int) or count < 0:
        raise ValueError("count must be a nonnegative integer")
    a, b = assignment
    nodes = tuple(i for i in range(6) if (a | b) & (1 << i))
    double = (a & b).bit_count()
    directed = 2 * sum(
        bool(word & (1 << i)) and bool(word & (1 << j))
        for word in (a, b)
        for i, j in EDGES
    )
    return Sample(
        assignment,
        len(nodes),
        nodes,
        double,
        directed,
        double == directed == 0,
        -len(nodes) + double + directed**2,
        count,
    )


def build_program(parameters: tuple[float, ...] = DEFAULT_PARAMS) -> synth.Program:
    """Reuse the frozen twelve-bit quantum encoding with explicit local limits."""
    if len(parameters) != 16 or any(
        isinstance(value, bool)
        or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
        or not math.isfinite(value)
        for value in parameters
    ):
        raise ValueError("eight layers require sixteen finite radian parameters")
    return synth.synthesize(
        main,
        classical_inputs={"params": parameters},
        max_qubits=12,
        max_workspace=0,
        max_operations=40000,
        memory_limit_bytes=16 * 1024**2,
    )


def read_distribution(program: synth.Program) -> tuple[float, ...]:
    """Execute and read both modeled color arrays over the complete joint domain."""
    if tuple(program.registers) != NAMES or tuple(
        len(program.registers[name]) for name in NAMES
    ) != (6, 6):
        raise ValueError("induced coloring requires six-bit a/b registers")
    readout = dict(program.probabilities(fq.run(program), registers=NAMES))
    if not set(readout).issubset(DOMAIN):
        raise ValueError("named readout lies outside the original joint domain")
    probabilities = tuple(readout.get(key, 0.0) for key in DOMAIN)
    lower_tail_cost(
        probabilities,
        tuple(model_row(key).retained_quantum_cost for key in DOMAIN),
        1.0,
    )
    return probabilities


def _validate_sampling(shots: int, seed: int) -> None:
    if (
        isinstance(shots, bool)
        or not isinstance(shots, int)
        or not 1 <= shots <= 100000
    ):
        raise ValueError("shots must be an integer in [1, 100000]")
    if isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int) or not 0 <= seed < 2**63:
        raise ValueError("seed must be a nonnegative 63-bit integer")


def sample_distribution(
    probabilities: tuple[float, ...], *, shots: int, seed: int
) -> tuple[Sample, ...]:
    """Draw actual joint samples and rank original feasibility and objective first."""
    _validate_sampling(shots, seed)
    lower_tail_cost(
        probabilities,
        tuple(model_row(key).retained_quantum_cost for key in DOMAIN),
        1.0,
    )
    draws = torch.multinomial(
        torch.tensor(probabilities, dtype=torch.float64),
        shots,
        replacement=True,
        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed),
    )
    counts = torch.bincount(draws, minlength=4096)
    return tuple(
        sorted(
            (
                model_row(key, int(counts[index]))
                for index, key in enumerate(DOMAIN)
                if int(counts[index]) > 0
            ),
            key=lambda row: (
                not row.feasible,
                -row.objective,
                row.retained_quantum_cost,
                row.assignment,
            ),
        )
    )


def run_workflow(*, maxiter: int = 50, shots: int = 1000, seed: int = 2718) -> Workflow:
    """Optimize the retained joint cost, sample, then compute an independent reference."""
    if (
        isinstance(maxiter, bool)
        or not isinstance(maxiter, int)
        or not 1 <= maxiter <= 128
    ):
        raise ValueError("maxiter must be an integer in [1, 128]")
    _validate_sampling(shots, seed)
    costs = tuple(model_row(key).retained_quantum_cost for key in DOMAIN)
    trace: list[Evaluation] = []

    def evaluate(parameters: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        values = tuple(float(value) for value in parameters)
        cost = lower_tail_cost(read_distribution(build_program(values)), costs, 0.7)
        trace.append(Evaluation(values, cost))
        return torch.tensor(cost, dtype=torch.float64)

    optimizer = NelderMeadOptimizer(maxiter=maxiter, initial_step=0.07).minimize(
        evaluate, torch.tensor(DEFAULT_PARAMS, dtype=torch.float64)
    )
    program = build_program(tuple(float(value) for value in optimizer.parameters))
    samples = sample_distribution(read_distribution(program), shots=shots, seed=seed)
    uniform = sample_distribution((1 / 4096,) * 4096, shots=shots, seed=31415)
    exact = min(
        (key for key in DOMAIN if model_row(key).feasible),
        key=lambda key: (-model_row(key).objective, key),
    )
    return Workflow(program, optimizer, tuple(trace), samples, uniform, exact)

"""Shared local optimization/readout for the two fixed subset-selection tutorials.

This is example code, not a general modeling API. Tables contain at most 256
assignments. Every optimizer call synthesizes and executes the native program.
"""

import math
from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.algorithms import NelderMeadOptimizer, NelderMeadResult

INITIAL_PARAMETERS = (0.13, -0.27, 0.19, 0.22, 0.31, -0.17)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Evaluation:
    """Parameters and lower-tail cost from one actual quantum execution."""

    parameters: tuple[float, ...]
    cost: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Sample:
    """A sampled subset, its feasibility, and actual observation count."""

    word: int
    nodes: tuple[int, ...]
    penalized_cost: float
    feasible: bool
    count: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SubsetWorkflow:
    """Bounded search, local samples, and an independently labeled exact reference."""

    program: synth.Program
    optimizer: NelderMeadResult
    trace: tuple[Evaluation, ...]
    optimized: tuple[Sample, ...]
    uniform: tuple[Sample, ...]
    exact_nodes: tuple[int, ...]

    @property
    def best_feasible(self) -> Sample | None:
        """Select the largest observed feasible subset, without using the oracle."""
        return next((row for row in self.optimized if row.feasible), None)


def lower_tail_cost(
    probabilities: Sequence[float], costs: Sequence[float], quantile: float
) -> float:
    """Integrate normalized cost mass through a possibly fractional quantile."""
    if not math.isfinite(quantile) or not 0 < quantile <= 1:
        raise ValueError("quantile must be finite and in (0, 1]")
    if len(probabilities) != len(costs) or not probabilities:
        raise ValueError("probabilities and costs must have the same positive length")
    if any(not math.isfinite(p) or p < 0 for p in probabilities):
        raise ValueError("probabilities must be finite and nonnegative")
    if abs(sum(probabilities) - 1) > 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("probabilities must sum to one")
    if any(not math.isfinite(cost) for cost in costs):
        raise ValueError("costs must be finite")
    mass, value = 0.0, 0.0
    for word in sorted(range(len(costs)), key=lambda w: (costs[w], w)):
        take = min(probabilities[word], quantile - mass)
        mass += take
        value += take * costs[word]
        if mass >= quantile - 1e-14:
            break
    return value / quantile


def selected_nodes(word: int, width: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Decode node i from bit i of the named numeric array value."""
    return tuple(i for i in range(width) if word & (1 << i))


def sample_subsets(
    probabilities: tuple[float, ...],
    costs: tuple[float, ...],
    feasible_words: frozenset[int],
    *,
    shots: int,
    seed: int,
) -> tuple[Sample, ...]:
    """Draw actual local samples and sort feasibility before unpenalized size."""
    if (
        isinstance(shots, bool)
        or not isinstance(shots, int)
        or not 1 <= shots <= 100000
    ):
        raise ValueError("shots must be an integer in [1, 100000]")
    if isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int) or not 0 <= seed < 2**63:
        raise ValueError("seed must be a nonnegative 63-bit integer")
    lower_tail_cost(probabilities, costs, 1.0)
    width = len(costs).bit_length() - 1
    if not 1 <= width <= 8 or len(costs) != 1 << width:
        raise ValueError("subset tables require 1..8 bits and a power-of-two length")
    if any(
        isinstance(w, bool) or not isinstance(w, int) or not 0 <= w < len(costs)
        for w in feasible_words
    ):
        raise ValueError("feasible assignments must be valid integer table indices")
    draws = torch.multinomial(
        torch.tensor(probabilities, dtype=torch.float64),
        shots,
        replacement=True,
        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed),
    )
    counts = torch.bincount(draws, minlength=len(costs))
    rows = (
        Sample(
            word,
            selected_nodes(word, width),
            costs[word],
            word in feasible_words,
            int(counts[word]),
        )
        for word in range(len(costs))
        if int(counts[word]) > 0
    )
    return tuple(
        sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (not row.feasible, -len(row.nodes), row.word))
    )


def read_distribution(program: synth.Program, width: int) -> tuple[float, ...]:
    """Execute and read the complete named array distribution in node order."""
    if tuple(program.registers) != ("v",) or len(program.registers["v"]) != width:
        raise ValueError("native program must expose only the declared v node array")
    probabilities = dict(program.probabilities(fq.run(program), registers=("v",)))
    if any(len(word) != 1 or not 0 <= word[0] < 1 << width for word in probabilities):
        raise ValueError("named readout contains an assignment outside the node array")
    return tuple(probabilities.get((word,), 0.0) for word in range(1 << width))


def run_subset_optimization(
    build_program: Callable[[tuple[float, ...]], synth.Program],
    costs: tuple[float, ...],
    feasible_words: frozenset[int],
    *,
    maxiter: int,
    shots: int = 1000,
    seed: int = 2718,
    quantile: float = 0.7,
) -> SubsetWorkflow:
    """Run bounded native optimization, sample it, then enumerate the reference.

    The exact reference is calculated after optimization and sample selection.
    It does not supply parameters, probabilities, or sampled candidate answers.
    """
    if (
        isinstance(maxiter, bool)
        or not isinstance(maxiter, int)
        or not 1 <= maxiter <= 128
    ):
        raise ValueError("maxiter must be an integer in [1, 128]")
    if not feasible_words:
        raise ValueError("the fixed problem must have at least one feasible assignment")
    uniform = tuple(1.0 / len(costs) for _ in costs) if costs else ()
    lower_tail_cost(uniform, costs, quantile)
    uniform_samples = sample_subsets(
        uniform, costs, feasible_words, shots=shots, seed=31415
    )
    # Validate the optimized sample controls before spending quantum executions.
    if isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int) or not 0 <= seed < 2**63:
        raise ValueError("seed must be a nonnegative 63-bit integer")
    width = len(costs).bit_length() - 1
    trace: list[Evaluation] = []

    def evaluate(parameters: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        values = tuple(float(value) for value in parameters)
        probabilities = read_distribution(build_program(values), width)
        cost = lower_tail_cost(probabilities, costs, quantile)
        trace.append(Evaluation(values, cost))
        return torch.tensor(cost, dtype=torch.float64)

    optimizer = NelderMeadOptimizer(maxiter=maxiter, initial_step=0.07).minimize(
        evaluate, torch.tensor(INITIAL_PARAMETERS, dtype=torch.float64)
    )
    program = build_program(tuple(float(value) for value in optimizer.parameters))
    probabilities = read_distribution(program, width)
    optimized = sample_subsets(
        probabilities, costs, feasible_words, shots=shots, seed=seed
    )
    exact_word = min(feasible_words, key=lambda word: (costs[word], word))
    return SubsetWorkflow(
        program,
        optimizer,
        tuple(trace),
        optimized,
        uniform_samples,
        selected_nodes(exact_word, width),
    )

"""Full eight-layer, twelve-bit native induced two-color subgraph program."""

import flagquantum as fq
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.synth import (
    RX,
    Output,
    QArray,
    QBit,
    allocate,
    hadamard_transform,
    phase,
    qfunc,
)


@qfunc
def cost(gamma: float, a: QArray[QBit], b: QArray[QBit]) -> None:
    phase(6, gamma)
    for j in range(6):
        phase(-(a[j] * b[j] + (1 - a[j]) * (1 - b[j])), gamma)
    phase(
        -4
        * (
            a[0] * a[1]
            + a[0] * a[2]
            + a[0] * a[4]
            + a[1] * a[2]
            + a[1] * a[3]
            + a[1] * a[5]
            + a[2] * a[3]
            + a[2] * a[4]
            + a[2] * a[5]
            + a[3] * a[4]
            + a[4] * a[5]
        )
        ** 2,
        gamma,
    )
    phase(
        -4
        * (
            b[0] * b[1]
            + b[0] * b[2]
            + b[0] * b[4]
            + b[1] * b[2]
            + b[1] * b[3]
            + b[1] * b[5]
            + b[2] * b[3]
            + b[2] * b[4]
            + b[2] * b[5]
            + b[3] * b[4]
            + b[4] * b[5]
        )
        ** 2,
        gamma,
    )
    phase(
        -8
        * (
            a[0] * a[1]
            + a[0] * a[2]
            + a[0] * a[4]
            + a[1] * a[2]
            + a[1] * a[3]
            + a[1] * a[5]
            + a[2] * a[3]
            + a[2] * a[4]
            + a[2] * a[5]
            + a[3] * a[4]
            + a[4] * a[5]
        )
        * (
            b[0] * b[1]
            + b[0] * b[2]
            + b[0] * b[4]
            + b[1] * b[2]
            + b[1] * b[3]
            + b[1] * b[5]
            + b[2] * b[3]
            + b[2] * b[4]
            + b[2] * b[5]
            + b[3] * b[4]
            + b[4] * b[5]
        ),
        gamma,
    )


@qfunc
def main(params: list[float], a: Output[QArray[QBit]], b: Output[QArray[QBit]]) -> None:
    allocate(6, a)
    allocate(6, b)
    hadamard_transform(a)
    hadamard_transform(b)
    for layer in range(8):
        cost(params[layer], a, b)
        for j in range(6):
            RX(params[8 + layer], a[j])
            RX(params[8 + layer], b[j])


DEFAULT_PARAMS = tuple(0.003 * (i + 1) * (-1 if i % 2 else 1) for i in range(16))


def build_program(params: tuple[float, ...] = DEFAULT_PARAMS) -> synth.Program:
    """Bind all eight cost and mixer layers, retaining zero compiler workspace."""
    if len(params) != 16:
        raise ValueError(
            "Eight induced-subgraph layers require sixteen real parameters"
        )
    return synth.synthesize(main, classical_inputs={"params": params}, max_workspace=0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    program = build_program()
    result = fq.run(program)
    print(program.report["resources"])
    print("State norm:", result.statevector().norm().item())

"""Show source graph, actual optimization, observations and observed coloring."""

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.axes import Axes
from matplotlib.figure import Figure

from .workflow import EDGES, Sample, Workflow


def _draw_graph(axis: Axes, row: Sample | None = None) -> None:
    graph = nx.Graph()
    graph.add_nodes_from(range(6))
    graph.add_edges_from(EDGES)
    positions = nx.circular_layout(graph)
    colors = [
        (
            "lightgray"
            if row is None or i not in row.colored_nodes
            else "cornflowerblue" if row.assignment[0] & (1 << i) else "coral"
        )
        for i in range(6)
    ]
    nx.draw_networkx(graph, pos=positions, node_color=colors, ax=axis)
    axis.set_axis_off()


def optimization_figure(workflow: Workflow) -> Figure:
    """Retain four figure roles with common fifty-bin empirical cost histograms."""
    figure, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8), constrained_layout=True)
    _draw_graph(axes[0, 0])
    axes[0, 0].set_title("Source graph: six nodes, eleven edges, two colors")
    axes[0, 1].plot([row.cost for row in workflow.trace])
    axes[0, 1].set(
        xlabel="Actual quantum evaluation",
        ylabel="Retained-cost lower-tail CVaR 0.7",
        title=f"Native bounded search; converged={workflow.optimizer.converged}",
    )
    rows = (*workflow.samples, *workflow.uniform)
    bins = np.linspace(
        min(row.retained_quantum_cost for row in rows),
        max(row.retained_quantum_cost for row in rows) + 1,
        51,
    )
    for label, samples in (
        ("Optimized", workflow.samples),
        ("Uniform", workflow.uniform),
    ):
        total = sum(row.count for row in samples)
        axes[1, 0].hist(
            [row.retained_quantum_cost for row in samples],
            bins=bins,
            weights=[row.count / total for row in samples],
            alpha=0.6,
            label=label,
        )
    axes[1, 0].legend()
    axes[1, 0].set(
        xlabel="Retained quantum penalty cost",
        ylabel="Empirical probability",
        title="Actual observations; common fifty-bin histograms",
    )
    best = workflow.best_feasible
    if best is None:
        axes[1, 1].axis("off")
        axes[1, 1].text(0.1, 0.5, "No feasible coloring was observed")
    else:
        _draw_graph(axes[1, 1], best)
        axes[1, 1].set_title(f"Best observed feasible coloring: {best.objective} nodes")
    optimized = sum(row.count for row in workflow.samples if row.feasible)
    uniform = sum(row.count for row in workflow.uniform if row.feasible)
    figure.suptitle(f"Feasible observations: {optimized} optimized, {uniform} uniform")
    return figure
